text: BrennanWSFC is already built. Now we create the actual high-availability mechanism on top of it: an AlwaysOn Availability Group called BrennanAG, spanning SQLDBA01 and SQLDBA02.

Three pieces, in order: BrennanAG itself, running synchronous-commit with automatic failover; BrennanERP as its only database; and BrennanAGListener, the one stable name every application connects through from now on.

On SQLDBA01, CREATE AVAILABILITY GROUP defines both replicas and adds BrennanERP in one statement -- synchronous-commit plus automatic failover makes this a true zero-data-loss failover, not just a replicated copy.

The listener gets its own IP so no app ever targets a server name directly. One fact worth remembering: adding any other database to BrennanAG later is never automatic -- it's always a deliberate backup, restore, and ADD DATABASE step.
BrennanAG and its listener are live and healthy. Next, we make sure BrennanERP's backups run themselves -- and actually prove they're restorable.
